entries.af5ce99202fc4dbe: Human Resources and Organizational Support Services
entries.bb03c06a7b04dfd9: This is the main business of the company and its three consolidated subsidiaries. For corporate clients, mainly management and middle management, it offers coaching services that support behavioral change and organizational capability improvement through business coaching, as well as human resources and organizational support services that underpin the practice of human capital management. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,587 million.

For individuals, it also runs Business Coach School, which teaches business coaching skills.
